clean-girl.name: Clean Girl
clean-girl.description: Minimal, polished, effortless. Neutral tones, slick buns, gold hoops, matcha, pilates. Life looks curated but calm.
visual_signals: Wardrobe leans neutral — beige, cream, white, black basics
Hair usually pulled back sleek; minimal 'no-makeup' makeup
Her camera roll is coffee cups, gym mirrors, and tidy corners of her apartment
Naturally tidy spaces; she already lights candles and makes her bed
clean-girl.aesthetic: Bright natural light, warm whites, minimal text on screen, lowercase captions
clean-girl.peer_watchlist_note: Watch clean-girl lifestyle creators for morning routine formats, matcha/pilates content, and 'aesthetic reset' videos — save formats you like to your inspiration folder each week.

gym-girl.name: Gym Girl
gym-girl.description: Fitness-forward but lifestyle-first. Progress, gym fits, meal prep, and the discipline-as-identity vibe.
visual_signals: Owns more athletic sets than jeans; hair in claw clips or braids
Comfortable filming herself in public gym settings
Talks about protein, steps, or lifting splits unprompted
Visible routine consistency — same gym time daily
gym-girl.aesthetic: Mirror angles, timestamps, sweat-and-done honesty, before/during energy
gym-girl.peer_watchlist_note: Watch lifestyle-fitness creators (not bodybuilders) for 'come to the gym with me' and what-I-eat formats each week.

soft-luxury.name: Soft Luxury
soft-luxury.description: The soft-life aesthetic: brunches, fresh flowers, nice hotels, small designer touches, self-care as a lifestyle.
visual_signals: Gravitates to gold jewelry, silk, neutrals with one luxe item
Photographs food and interiors instinctively
Loves a ritual: nails every two weeks, fresh flowers weekly
Speaks softly/calmly on camera; elegant energy over loud energy
soft-luxury.aesthetic: Warm golden light, slow pans, minimal talking, ambient audio or soft trending sounds
soft-luxury.peer_watchlist_note: Watch soft-life and 'romanticize your life' creators for table-scape, hotel, and self-care ritual formats.

girl-next-door.name: Girl Next Door
girl-next-door.description: Relatable, warm, a little chaotic. Target runs, thrifting, pets, roommates, real laughing-at-herself energy.
visual_signals: Messy bun, oversized hoodie, comfortable being unpolished on camera
Storytelling comes naturally — she narrates her day without prompting
Pets, siblings, or roommates constantly in frame
Finds humor in small daily fails
girl-next-door.aesthetic: Front-camera talking, unfiltered lighting, captions with personality, face-first content
girl-next-door.peer_watchlist_note: Watch relatable day-in-the-life and 'come with me to Target' creators for talking-story and errand-vlog formats.

alt-edgy.name: Alt / Edgy
alt-edgy.description: Tattoos, piercings, band tees, dark wardrobe, concerts, art. Softness underneath the edge is the hook.
visual_signals: Wardrobe is 80% black; statement boots or jewelry
Has tattoos/piercings or wants them; strong music identity
Aesthetic instincts lean moody — dim lighting, film grain
Contrast content (edgy look, soft hobbies) feels natural to her
alt-edgy.aesthetic: Moody light, flash photos at night, grain, handwritten-style text, alt/indie audio
alt-edgy.peer_watchlist_note: Watch alt-fashion and concert-lifestyle creators for fit-check transitions and flash-photo-dump formats.

glam-baddie.name: Glam / Baddie
glam-baddie.description: Full glam, nights out, makeup skill, confidence-forward. The transformation is the content.
visual_signals: Strong makeup skills or high interest in learning
Owns going-out wardrobe; comfortable dressing up midweek
Loves a GRWM — talks naturally while doing makeup
Confident direct-to-camera presence
glam-baddie.aesthetic: Ring light + city night light, GRWM voiceovers, sharp transitions on beat
glam-baddie.peer_watchlist_note: Watch GRWM and nightlife creators for get-ready transition formats and voiceover storytelling.

country-outdoors.name: Country / Outdoors
country-outdoors.description: Sunsets, lakes, trucks, boots, bonfires. Slower pace, golden hour, small-town warmth.
visual_signals: Denim, boots, sundresses; natural makeup
Most of her camera roll is outside — fields, water, sky
Comfortable with animals, driving content, campfires
Golden-hour instincts; her best photos are outdoors
country-outdoors.aesthetic: Golden hour everything, country/folk audio, wide shots, minimal editing
country-outdoors.peer_watchlist_note: Watch country-lifestyle creators for truck-radio talking clips, sunset formats, and weekend-recap dumps.

wellness-itgirl.name: Wellness It-Girl
wellness-itgirl.description: Journaling, yoga, farmers markets, reading, smoothies. Growth and intention as an aesthetic.
visual_signals: Already journals, reads, or does yoga off-camera
Farmers market / health food store is a genuine habit
Calm speaking voice, thoughtful captions
Drawn to sunrise, nature walks, tea, crystals, or all four
wellness-itgirl.aesthetic: Soft daylight, slow cuts, voiceover journaling tone, ambient sounds
wellness-itgirl.peer_watchlist_note: Watch wellness and 'that girl' creators for habit-stack formats, silent vlogs, and sunday-reset content.
